jobs.title: Full Stack Developer
jobs.description:
OverviewJob Title Note: We are advertising this opportunity as Full Stack Developer to align with common market terminology and help candidates find the role. Internally, this position is titled Software Engineer.Good things are happening at Berkshire Hathaway GUARD Insurance Companies—an A+ (Superior) rated, nationwide Property & Casualty insurer backed by Berkshire Hathaway. With supportive leadership, collaborative teams, and opportunities to grow, GUARD is a place where people build meaningful, long‑term careers.Good Things You Can Count On. Hybrid schedule: 2 days remote / 3 in‑office Predictable hours (no nights, weekends, or holidays) Competitive pay + generous PTO Medical, dental & vision starting day one 401(k), tuition reimbursement & longevity bonusesResponsibilitiesWe are growing our engineering organization and seeking Full Stack Developers across all experience levels who are excited about modern software development and AI-enabled engineering practices.This is an opportunity to work in an environment where cloud-first architecture, automation, and AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot and enterprise AI solutions) are actively embraced to improve productivity, code quality, and developer experience.Whether you are early in your career or an experienced engineer, you’ll contribute to building scalable systems while continuously evolving your technical and AI-assisted development skills.What You Can Expect A modern engineering culture focused on: AI-assisted development and productivity tools  Cloud-first application design  Continuous learning and upskilling  Strong mentorship and career growth paths Role ResponsibilitiesResponsibilities will scale based on experience level and may include:Core Engineering Design, develop, and maintain modern full-stack applications  Build and integrate APIs and responsive user interfaces  Write clean, secure, testable, and maintainable code  Collaborate within Agile teams to deliver business value Modern Engineering Practices Leverage AI-assisted coding tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot) to accelerate development and improve quality  Contribute to cloud-first development practices using Azure services  Participate in CI/CD pipelines, automation, and DevOps practices  Help evolve engineering standards, reusable components, and best practices Performance, Quality & Collaboration Monitor and optimize application performance and scalability  Build and execute automated tests (unit, integration, end-to-end)  Participate in code reviews and knowledge sharing  Partner with product and business stakeholders on solution design Advanced Contributions (Mid–Senior Levels) Influence system architecture and design decisions  Mentor junior developers and support team growth  Drive adoption of modern tools, frameworks, and AI capabilities  Lead technical initiatives and continuous improvement efforts QualificationsWe intentionally welcome candidates at different experience levels. If you meet many—but not all—of these, we encourage you to apply.Foundational Qualifications Degree in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent practical experience  Understanding of software development fundamentals  Experience or exposure to object-oriented programming and web development  Strong problem-solving skills and a growth mindset Technical Skills (Experience-Based) Backend development experience (C#/.NET or similar technologies)  Front-end development using modern frameworks (React, Angular, Vue, etc.)  Understanding of RESTful APIs and web services  Familiarity with cloud platforms (Azure preferred)  Experience with databases (SQL and/or NoSQL)  Knowledge of version control (Git) and collaborative workflows Modern Engineering & AI (Preferred) Experience using AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, etc.)  Familiarity with cloud-native architectures and microservices  Understanding of CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices  Exposure to application security and identity standards (OAuth, OpenID)  Experience working in Agile environments (Scrum, Kanban) Career Growth & DevelopmentThis Role Supports a Wide Range Of Career Paths Early Career: Build foundational skills with mentorship and guided development  Mid-Level: Take ownership of features and expand technical depth  Senior-Level: Lead design decisions, mentor others, and shape engineering practices We Actively Invest In Our Engineers Through Hands-on learning and real-world problem solving  AI and modern engineering skill development  Clear advancement paths across technical and leadership tracks Salary Ran ge $77,762.70 - $180,082.10 + bonusIn accordance with applicable pay transparency laws, this range represents a good-faith estimate. Final compensation will be determined based on factors such as experience, credentials, geographic location, and other considerations permitted by law.This role may be based out of any of our office locations, including:Parsippany, NJ; Conshohocken, PA; Wilkes ‑ Barre, PA; Alpharetta, GA; Scottsdale, AZApplicants must be authorized to work in the U.S. without current or future sponsorship.Interview Integrity Notice: Berkshire Hathaway GUARD is committed to a fair and consistent hiring process. Candidates are expected to participate independently in interviews. Unauthorized recording, transcription, AI note-taking, or AI interview assistance tools may not be used during interviews without prior approval.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Full Stack Developer / Senior Full Stack Developer / Lead Full Stack DeveloperLocation: Remote, with onsite travel to corporate offices a few times per quarterCompensation: $125,000 – $160,000 base salary, depending on experience and levelEmployment Type: Full-time, direct hireOverviewWe are seeking Full Stack Developers at multiple levels, from Senior Developer through Lead Developer, to help build, modernize, and support enterprise web applications using Microsoft and modern front-end technologies. This role is ideal for someone who is strong in C#, .NET, Azure, Angular, TypeScript, and related full stack development tools, and who enjoys working across both application architecture and hands-on coding.This is a primarily remote role, but candidates must be willing to travel onsite to the corporate offices a few times per quarter for planning sessions, team collaboration, and key project meetings.ResponsibilitiesDesign, develop, test, and support full stack web applications using C#, .NET, Angular, TypeScript, and Azure.Build and maintain RESTful APIs, backend services, and application integrations.Develop modern front-end interfaces using Angular, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.Work with SQL Server and related database technologies to design queries, stored procedures, and data models.Use Entity Framework, LINQ, and other .NET tools to build scalable and maintainable data access layers.Participate in cloud-based application development, deployment, and support within Microsoft Azure.Collaborate with product owners, business stakeholders, QA, DevOps, and other developers to deliver reliable software solutions.Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve application issues across front-end, back-end, database, and cloud environments.Contribute to code reviews, technical design discussions, and development best practices.For Lead-level candidates: mentor developers, help guide architecture decisions, lead technical planning, and support project delivery across development teams.Required QualificationsStrong hands-on experience with C# and .NET / .NET Core.Experience building full stack web applications.Front-end development experience with Angular and TypeScript.Experience with SQL Server, relational databases, and writing efficient queries.Experience with Entity Framework, LINQ, REST APIs, and object-oriented programming.Working knowledge of Microsoft Azure services and cloud-based application development.Experience with source control tools such as Git, Azure DevOps, GitHub, or similar.Ability to work independently in a remote environment while collaborating with cross-functional teams.Willingness to travel onsite to corporate offices a few times per quarter.Preferred QualificationsExperience with React or other modern JavaScript frameworks.Experience with Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, automated deployments, or cloud infrastructure.Familiarity with microservices, distributed systems, or enterprise application architecture.Experience modernizing legacy .NET applications.Experience with unit testing, integration testing, and secure coding practices.Prior experience in a senior, lead, or mentoring capacity.Ideal CandidateThe ideal candidate is a hands-on full stack developer who is comfortable working across the full application stack, from database and API development to modern front-end interfaces. They should be able to contribute technically, communicate clearly with business and technology teams, and help deliver scalable, high-quality applications in a Microsoft/Azure environment.For Lead-level candidates, the ideal person will also bring strong technical leadership, mentoring ability, and experience helping shape architecture, standards, and delivery practices.Compensation & Work ArrangementThis role offers a base salary range of $125,000 to $160,000, based on experience and level. The position is remote for the majority of the year, with required onsite visits to the corporate offices a few times per quarter for collaboration and planning.
